method: Blind: two fresh-context labelling agents, 13 repositories each, cloned every repository at its pinned commit and read manifests of every ecosystem, env templates, configuration and source, never Refit code, catalog or output. AI-assisted reading, not hand labelling and not second-labelled. Vendor ids are the labellers' own; scripts/vendor-detection-benchmark.mjs maps them to catalog ids.
heldOut: Batch a was not read until after data/vendor-catalog.json was written (commit c24514d8). Batch b's vendor summary was seen while drafting that catalog, so a few of its long-tail vendors (langfuse, exa, new-relic, huggingface) may have been added because of it; score batch a as held out.
unit: One (repository, vendor) pair: a hosted API or SaaS vendor the repository integrates with through a declared package (any ecosystem, dev included), a request to its API host from non-test code or config, or credentials it reads (an env name in code or an env template). Links, comments, docs and test-only mocks do not count. A repository that is a vendor SDK uses that vendor. Uncertain pairs count neither for nor against detection.
